name: Negev Museum of Art
notes: Verified 2026-09-18 by direct fetch. Only major art museum in southern Israel (housed in Ottoman-era building, old city Be'er Sheva). Confirmed live programming: current exhibitions through 2026-12-26, plus Sukkot creative workshops + guided tours + puppet show on 2026-09-28. Confirms Be'er Sheva as a market with real, currently-active art/culture institution.

name: Herzliya Museum of Contemporary Art
notes: Verified 2026-09-18 by direct fetch. IMPORTANT CAVEAT: the museum's main exhibition space is currently closed for renovation/accessibility works per its own homepage ('currently closed for renovation, renewal, and accessibility improvements'). Its education arm 'Muza' continues running courses/workshops for children, youth and adults (phone 09-9500762) -- that program, not the exhibition space, is the currently-active piece. The Herzliya Biennial (2007/2009/2011) ended after 2011 and is NOT currently active -- do not cite it as a recurring event. Confirms Herzliya only via the Muza education program, not the museum's exhibitions.

name: Design Museum Holon
notes: Verified 2026-09-18. Real, actively operating design museum (Ron Arad-designed building). Current large-scale exhibition 'The Circle - Designing New Realities' runs through May 2027. NOTE: 'design' is not itself a controlled discipline vocab value (only sound/music/performance/dance/painting/sculpture) -- tagged interdisciplinary as the closest fit; flagging as a possible future vocab gap, not proposing action here (out of scope of this research pass).

name: Acco Festival of Alternative Israeli Theatre (Municipality of Akko)
notes: Verified via akko.org.il, accofestival.co.il, Wikipedia, and Times of Israel 2026-09-18. Long-running (est. 1980), city-produced 4-day festival held during Sukkot intermediate days in the Old City citadel -- covers street theatre, dance, avant-garde performance, concerts and workshops. NEEDS VERIFICATION: exact 2026 dates not confirmed on the official page in this session; Sukkot 2026 runs 2026-09-25 to 2026-10-02, so the festival's intermediate days would fall approximately 2026-09-27 to 2026-10-01 -- confirm on accofestival.co.il before publishing an exact date.

name: Red Sea Jazz Festival
notes: Verified 2026-09-18 via redseajazz.co.il, Wikipedia, Carnifest. Long-running (est. 1987) outdoor jazz festival at Eilat port; 2026 edition (40th) confirmed 2026-11-11 to 2026-11-14, includes 6 workshops with guest artists in addition to nightly concerts. Confirms Eilat as a market with real, currently-active, dated cultural event.

name: Ramat Gan Museum of Israeli Art
notes: Verified 2026-09-18. Only museum dedicated specifically to contemporary Israeli art; reopened 2021 after renovation. Website confirms an ongoing program of lectures, children's shows, art classes, workshops and tours alongside 5 concurrent exhibition halls. Confirms Ramat Gan as a market with real, currently-active institution.

name: Heichal HaTarbut Rishon LeZion (Rishon LeZion Cultural Hall)
notes: Verified 2026-09-18 via Rishon LeZion Foundation and Time Out Israel. City's largest cultural venue/auditorium; hosts theatre, music and dance performances, the International Spring Festival, and holds regular dance/theatre classes. NEEDS VERIFICATION: could not confirm the exact 2026/27 International Spring Festival dates or current class schedule directly on the venue's own site in this session.

name: Municipal Art Gallery Rishon LeZion
notes: Found 2026-09-18 via AICF (Artists in Contemporary Fine Arts). name: Mahmoud Darwish Cultural Center (Nazareth)
notes: Verified 2026-09-18 via Nazareth360 (independent Nazareth tourism site) -- NOT to be confused with the separate Mahmoud Darwish Foundation & Museum in Ramallah, Palestine (different institution, different country). Real 280-seat theatre hall in Nazareth (address/phone confirmed: +972-4-6571672), hosts the named recurring 'Nazareth Festival of Contemporary Dance' plus theatre plays, concerts and films. NEEDS VERIFICATION: could not confirm current-year festival dates or an official municipal/venue website (visitnazareth.co.il link for this venue 404'd) -- this is the weakest-evidenced city in this batch; recheck before treating Nazareth as fully confirmed.

name: Beit HaGefen Arab-Jewish Culture Center
notes: Verified 2026-09-18. Real, long-running (est. 1963) Haifa institution combining a contemporary art gallery, a theatre, a library and dialogue programming. Runs a recurring 'Arab Theater Month' each summer and the annual 'Holiday of Holidays' festival (Ramadan/Christmas/Hanukkah) each December, plus regular workshops and exhibitions.

name: Suzanne Dellal Centre for Dance and Theatre
notes: Verified 2026-09-18: registration page (suzannedellal.org.il/en/registration/) is live and functioning, confirming the centre actively runs workshops, masterclasses and open classes (incl. Gaga movement classes) alongside its performance programme -- not just a presenting venue. Previously flagged in the 2026-09-17 batch as 'off-cycle, no open call'; this entry is specifically about its workshop/class programming, a different content type (events, not opportunities).

name: Machol Shalem Dance House (MASH)
notes: Verified 2026-09-18 by direct fetch of the open-call page. Runs the annual Jerusalem International Dance Week (since 2006) and the Jerusalem International Choreography Competition -- see matching opportunity row opp_stg_037 and event rows for the 2026 dates.

name: Musrara -- The Naggar School of Photography
notes: active
column15: Verified 2026-09-18. Active art school (est. 1987) in the Musrara neighbourhood with 5 departments (Photography, New Media, New Music, Visual Communication, Phototherapy) on a 3-year track, plus public-facing workshops (calligraphy, bookbinding, printmaking) and community programmes.

name: Yellow Submarine
notes: Verified 2026-09-18. Jerusalem's main music-education venue/concert space since 1991; runs a summer masterclass programme with visiting Israeli artists, professional sound-engineering courses, and youth 'Band Project' instruction.

name: Jerusalem Music Centre (JMC)
notes: Verified 2026-09-18 by direct fetch of the masterclasses page. notes: Found 2026-09-18 via Jerusalem Foundation, Wikipedia, Filmmakers.eu. Real, long-running (est. 1963) Tel Aviv acting school; offers part-time adult/high-school acting courses alongside its 3-year professional programme, and has hosted celebrity masterclasses (e.g. Kevin Spacey, per Ynet).
